published_source: Printed Table 7, column (3) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2022.4326.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. The article numbers its tables differently from the code: the code's Table 6 is the printed Table 7 (Directorships of Regulators and F-Score); the printed Table 4 is summary statistics. The spec's table field keeps the code numbering. Earlier: Not from the article (no article text in the project). Authors' 'code final.do' Tables 4-6 block re-run in Stata MP 16.1 (reghdfe 5.7.3) on the shipped samplems.dta (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.4326/stata/t4_t6.do, log t4_t6.log); fixest reproduces it to 7 digits. Column numbers inferred from code order (no-controls column first).
table_note: published article numbering (Nov 4 2026); the authors' code and log number this table 6, which earlier records used
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.0412993 (0.0245836), N 6925, equals printed Table 7, column (3) 0.041 (0.025), N 6,925, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Table 6 column (3): reghdfe highriskf1 treatnonom if insnn==1, absorb(i.fyear##i.sic2 i.gvkey) cluster(gvkey) ('code final.do' Tables 4-6 block, lines 469-491). Outcome: F-score > 1 (0/1). Treatment: FREP Head of Enforcement or FREP board member on the firm's board during FREP tenure; hand-coded by gvkey and fiscal year in 'code final.do' lines 137-387. Sample insnn = e(sample) of the authors' with-controls regression (fyear > 2003, non-missing treatment and lagged controls, singletons dropped): German listed non-financial firms 2004-2019, 697 firms. FE: firm + two-digit-SIC-by-year (xt_vars = sic2 gives id + t + t^sic2, which spans reghdfe's fyear + sic2 + fyear#sic2). sic2 comes from historical SIC (sich) and varies over time for 71 of 697 firms, so the industry-by-year FE are not strictly a time-invariant characteristic x time; TWFE/BJS use the row-level sic2 exactly as the authors do. 22 treated firms (115 treated firm-years), 675 never-treated firms (97.2% of rows). First-treated years: 2004:8(8 always-treated), 2005:2, 2007:3(1), 2008:2, 2011:1, 2012:1, 2013:1, 2014:2(1), 2017:1(1), 2018:1(1). Cohorts with pre- and post-treatment rows: 2005, 2007, 2008, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014. Switch-offs in the regression sample: 29 firm-years with treatnonom = 0 after first treatment (KUKA 2010-2019, Terex 2011-2012, Loewe 2007-2012, Schloss Wachenheim 2011-2019, Diebold Nixdorf 2017-2018), coded 0 because treatnonom is generated from treatheadten == 1 with post-tenure missings set to 0. run_spec.R drops them (Hull fn 6), so the run_spec TWFE (x outcome SD) equals the fixest TWFE on the protocol sample (twfe_raw_protocol_sample), not the authors' coefficient. The adjacent with-controls column (laglogat lagroa leverage lagmtb ma big4, winsorized) is not eligible.
